buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original

delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses MANUFACTURER AUTHORIZATION FORM (MAF) MANDATE: All bidding resellers/vendors must mandatory uplo ad a genuine, valid, and Bid-Specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) issued directly by the OEM (Original Eq uipment Manufacturer) on their official letterhead, referencing this specific GeM Bid Number and Date. General, gen eric, or stock authorization letters will be summarily rejected, and the bidder will be technically disqualified. GENUINE FACTORY PRELOADED OPERATING SYSTEM: The Operating System must be Windows 11 Professional (64-bit) Commercial Edition, genuine and Factory Preloaded by the OEM from the production/assembly line. The digi tal license key must be permanently embedded in the motherboard's BIOS/Firmware. Bidders must provide an offici al declaration from the OEM confirming the factory-preloaded OS status along with an Anti-Malware / Clean Code cer tificate. COMPREHENSIVE ONSITE OEM WARRANTY: The system must be supplied with a minimum 3-Year Next Business Day (NBD) Comprehensive Onsite OEM Warranty covering all hardware components, labor, and the display panel. T he warranty status of the delivered machines must be officially active and verifiable on the OEM’s public portal usin g the unique device Serial Number / Service Tag immediately upon delivery. Standalone reseller or third-party warra nties are strictly non-acceptable. REGULATORY COMPLIANCES & QUALITY CERTIFICATIONS: The quoted All-in-One PC model must possess valid, active, and verifiable certifications, including Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Registration under the compulsory re gistration scheme, EPEAT Gold/Silver, and ENERGY STAR compliance. Clear, legible copies of all these certificates m ust be uploaded along with the technical bid documen LOCAL SERVICE SUPPORT MANDATE: The Bidder or the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) must have a fu nctional, fully equipped, and authorized Service Centre in the State of the Consignee / Buyer's Headquarters (or with in a radius of 120 Kms from the delivery location). The bidder must submit a valid documentary proof, such as the of ficial address, contact details, email, and GST registration or OEM authorization letter of the local service centre, alo ng with the technical bid. Escalate-to-OEM matrix with toll-free helpline numbers must be provided for immediate su pport. Bids without verified local service support will be summarily rejected MANDATORY INSTALLATION AND COMMISSIONING BY OEM/BIDDER: The successful bidder/OEM must provid e free-of-cost, comprehensive on-site installation, configuration, and commissioning of all ordered All-in-One PCs at t he delivery locations within 7 days of supply. The installation must include unboxing, hardware assembly, integratio n of the wired keyboard and mouse, operating system activation (Windows 11 Pro), network/domain domain configu ration, and testing of peripheral ports, web camera, and speakers. The bidder must submit a signed and stamped Joi nt Inspection Report (JIR) or Installation Certificate duly counter-signed by the designated department official before raising the final invoice for payment." .
